source_evidence: Exact player 'Wait hell no, Fenar would have tried to kill these two and Cirren would have rolled the dead, I am fine' immediately corrects companion tactics in saved R7–R8. Preserve R7 S1/S2 actions, actual Burning Hands damage10, V10→0 unconscious, F second failed death save, Mara withdrawal, and C's final L2 Healing Word on F actual4,1+5=10. No claim V remained conscious. Supersede only prior R7 C Dash, F Medicine stabilization, resulting omitted V death save, and R8 passive C/F tactics; preserve original R8 enemy withdrawal and invisibility, Mara movement, and same C L1 Healing Word on V actual1+5=6, with revised intervening V state. Prior Medicine face13 is audit-only, no use. R7 C moves from(15,50,0) to(26,57,0) rough cost26.08ft, action Toll the Dead at visible full-health S1(65,70,10), within60ft. Magic Resistance Wis advantage9,9 keep9−3=6/DC16 fails; 2d8=6,6=12 necrotic, S1 36→24. C L2 1→0 via preserved BA heal. F stands20ft before activating final Rage BA (1→0/4), Beast Claws, and spends2MP OA (2→0/6), speed70 this turn; moves from(46,65,10) to(61,68,10) cost30.59ft rough terrain, within4.47ft of S1, total50.59ft. Reckless Attack: paired Double-Claw Rend adv1,3 keep3+8=11 vsAC13 misses; Beast Claw adv2,13 keep13+8=21 hit, d6=3+7=10; extra Beast Claw adv9,9 keep9+8=17 hit, d6=5+7=12. S1 24→2/36. F10/59 upright, OA ends at turn end. V dying R7 turn, Reborn death save advantage6,15 keep15+2=17 succeeds, 1 success0 failures. Actual new visible batchc652c01e0d53d8c57374258db41d1b2c. R8 S2 continues beyond threshold invisible; S1 still alive casts L2 Invisibility (1→0), moves to fissure threshold(70,80,10), no Hide, no visible OA target; original retreat remains legal. Mara coach to(0,-80) intact. C moves toward V from(26,57,0) to(39,59,5) rough cost~28.14ft; casts same preserved L1 Healing Word on V, actual old batch28293536e1cdd62459f389b7f28a8c80 d4=1+5=6, V0→6/48 conscious prone, death save reset. C slots3/0/0. Toll the Dead requires sight so C cannot directly target either invisible savant; instead Ready Toll the Dead for first visible hostile within60ft, concentration and reaction available, no slot. F follows S1's audible retreat footsteps (no Hide by S1, not automatic vision) from(61,68,10) to(67,76,10), rough cost20ft, 5ft from S1 at threshold. Reckless advantage cancels invisibility disadvantage; normal d20=15+8=23 vsAC13 hit, d12=3+7=10 slashing, S1 2→0 dead, Invisibility ends. No further melee attack on dead target; S2 remains unseen beyond threshold with no established precise location. F independently activates Shift BA to gain6 temporary HP (Shift3→2/3), no eligible fang target, remains active Rage Beast Claws and upright, no additional MP. Actual visible batch8f1ee008f31b838e8d10f50656d47950. No V action, resource spending, movement, additional enemy or chase beyond verified entrance. R8 V fresh turn, one surviving enemy S2 at2/36 invisible withdrawing. Original chunk retained immutable; corrected companion actions and dependent states supersede original exact events D337-R7-CIRREN-HEALS-FENAR-STABILIZES-V-001 and D337-R8-SAVANTS-RETREAT-CIRREN-REVIVES-V-001 to specified extent only.
